digestAlgorithm: sha256 over the manifest file list, one 'path:sha256' line per file in manifest order, joined by newline (manifest.json itself excluded)
approvalRef: Owner approval of v0.1.0 as the initial baseline, given in the design session https://claude.ai/code/session_01PxTQ4DFyiXW1FyvyEPxc9a on 2026-10-28. The approved content is unchanged from the validated commit d4ab45e; only approval metadata and release notes were added.
tagTarget: The commit that contains this record. Resolve with: git rev-parse guidance-v0.1.0^{commit}. The tag is annotated and must never be moved or deleted.
knownLimitations: preset.notification is provisional: the owner's toast reference could not be compared with this implementation. Typography, spacing, icon treatment, placement and motion are not visually approved.

Heuristic checks CHK-005, 007, 009, 010, 012, 014, 015 and 016 are specified in checks/rules.json but not implemented in the reference evaluator (scripts/run-checks.mjs). Objective checks implemented there: CHK-001, 002, 003, 004, 006, 008, 011, 013, 017, 018, 019, 020, 021, 022.
Input placeholder text uses --text-3, which is 3.24:1 on --s2 and below the 4.5:1 guideline. A token level decision is deferred to the owner.

Touch hit area verification uses Chromium hit testing and interior tap probes; range sliders are checked for size only, and Chromium's own touch adjustment near adjacent clickable edges is not controlled by CSS.
The Summa default design system (charcoal with a lime accent) differs from Summa-UI (charcoal with emerald). Reconciling them is an owner decision handled in the Summa integration pull request.
Icon shapes come from Lucide 1.62.0 and differ slightly from the earlier hand-drawn set.
The bundle has been evaluated on the 12 laboratory prototypes only; it has not yet been used to build a previously unseen application.
